task.title: Sleep Evidence product design (Recovery stream): IA, screens, charts, states, v2 gating, future hooks

result.summary: Design-only: Sleep becomes the first real content of the existing Recovery Evidence stream. Selective landing (last night, 14-night total chart with 7-night average, sleep window consistency, recent nights, sources); deeper Trends and Night detail (hypnogram, stages, continuity, in-bed, additional sleep, provenance). Stage/continuity gated by read-model status so sleep-canon-v2 values plug in without layout change. No score, no strategic weighting; future Briefing Recovery card, foam rolling and V3 association principles recorded as hooks only. Smallest Slice 1 recommended.

review.summary: Grounded in current Native Evidence code and canonical schema.

decisions_required: Show September validation data in Evidence? (recommend no)
Show Morning Check-In self-reported sleep next to HealthKit Sleep?
Recovery stream as Sleep's home vs separate Sleep row (design assumes Recovery)
Awakening count in continuity? (excluded by default)
Authorize Slice 1 implementation after sleep-canon-v2 + new D0
unexpected_findings: Evidence hub already has a placeholder 'recovery' stream (bed icon, teal) that Sleep can fill without a new hub row.
backlog: Slice 1 Server read model + Native Recovery landing/night detail
Slice 2 window chart, hypnogram, stages, continuity, trends
Slice 3 additional sleep, stage mix, training context
recommended_next_step: Founder reviews the design and the 4 open decisions; then authorize Slice 1 to follow sleep-canon-v2 and prospective activation.
